Common HTML entities are decoded in output

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<p>&amp; &lt; &gt; &nbsp; &quot; &apos;</p>"
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
